answer: Staked peer review plus spot checks that rerun the work from scratch. Attestations from one subnet are discounted by half, so rented IP blocks buy no weight at the wharf. A spot check pulls a random 10 percent of approvals each epoch and reruns them; the copies the tide drags in die there, before the horizon of payout. Cost per fake identity: one stake, one rerun, three times the honest work.
